Jun 21 2026

The Man Among the Tombs

Preacher · The Rev. Hannah Wycliffe Sunday, June 21, 2026 Proper 7 · Pentecost +4
Luke 8:26–39 · Galatians 3:23–29 · Isaiah 65:1–9 · Psalm 22:19–28

What we do with the people our communities have decided are too much — and what Jesus does instead, on the far side of the lake.

The Woman with the Jar

Preacher · The Rev. Marcus Adlersson Sunday, June 14, 2026 Proper 6 · Pentecost +3
Luke 7:36–8:3 · Galatians 2:15–21 · 2 Samuel 11:26—12:10, 13–15 · Psalm 32

A dinner party, an alabaster jar, and the woman whose tears wash the feet of Christ. On extravagance, gratitude, and the people the rest of us cannot quite forgive.

Jun 07 2026

At the Gate of Nain

Preacher · The Rev. Hannah Wycliffe Sunday, June 7, 2026 Proper 5 · Pentecost +2
Luke 7:11–17 · Galatians 1:11–24 · 1 Kings 17:8–24 · Psalm 30

When Jesus meets the funeral procession of the widow's only son, he does not call for faith. He has compassion. The Rector on what we forget about Easter, six weeks in.

The Three Who Hold the World

John 16:12–15 · Romans 5:1–5 · Proverbs 8:1–4, 22–31 · Canticle 13

Trinity Sunday: the day every preacher dreads. The Rector tries, without quite succeeding, to talk about the mystery at the heart of how Christians have come to know God.

What the Wind Does

Acts 2:1–21 · John 14:8–17, 25–27 · Romans 8:14–17 · Psalm 104:25–35, 37

A small church in Maine in late May, and the same Spirit that fell on a room in Jerusalem. The Rector preaches at the festal Eucharist, with red on the altar and the parish choir at full strength.

That They May Be One

John 17:20–26 · Acts 16:16–34 · Revelation 22:12–14, 16–17, 20–21 · Psalm 97

Jesus' last prayer for the disciples is a prayer for unity. The Curate asks what that prayer is asking of a church that has not, historically, been very good at unity.

Peace I Leave with You

John 14:23–29 · Acts 16:9–15 · Revelation 21:10, 22—22:5 · Psalm 67

The peace that Christ gives is not the peace the world gives. The Rector on what it might mean to receive a peace that does not depend on circumstance.

John 13:31–35 · Acts 11:1–18 · Revelation 21:1–6 · Psalm 148

The Voice of the Shepherd

John 10:22–30 · Acts 9:36–43 · Revelation 7:9–17 · Psalm 23

Breakfast on the Beach

Thomas, and the Honest Question
